scope: Conditional electrical/thermal screens for exact native compact copper; hardware and fabricator qualification incomplete
accuracy_limitation: A4988 5% accuracy specification is at VREF=2V and 100%/70.71% DAC; this 1.1V candidate is not covered by that test condition. 38.27% DAC specifies 15% at 2V.

sense_paths.scope: Full explicit trace lengths counted even inside supplier lands; a conservative positive trace-only screen. Ground return, shunt TCR and switching offset excluded. The terminal via is not a series barrel in this top-only path.
